Track both the maximum and minimum products of nonempty subarrays ending at each position. Initialize both and the overall best to nums[0]. For each subsequent value x, compute the new maximum and minimum from x, x times the previous maximum, and x times the previous minimum; then update the overall best. Both updates must use the old values, because a negative number can turn the previous minimum into the new maximum.

Invariant: after each position, those two states are exactly the largest and smallest products of subarrays ending there, and the overall best is the largest product seen anywhere so far.

Time: O(n). Extra space: O(1).
